content:
[0] The upcoming Apple TV 4K is about to launch and is expected to be unveiled at the iPhone event in a few weeks. Apple code leaks discovered by MacRumors also show that an all-new Siri Remote will debut alongside it.

[1] macOS Code Mentions Next-Generation Apple TV Remote

[2] Apple yesterday rolled out a flurry of public and beta software updates at once. The update contents of macOS 26.7 RC include references to several as-yet-unannounced products.

[3] MacRumors also discovered a video demonstrating AirPods with a built-in camera in action.

[4] The new Siri Remote for Apple TV 4K also appears in this list of unreleased products. Juli Clover wrote:

[5] Mark Gurman previously reported that the upcoming hardware refresh would feature a "likely improved Apple TV remote."

[6] The discovery of this next-generation Siri Remote within macOS 26.7 suggests that the new remote will indeed arrive this fall.

[7] There are currently no rumors pointing to specific changes for the new remote. However, one commonly requested feature is the ability to locate a lost remote more easily. Apple could potentially incorporate the second-generation Ultra Wideband chip used in AirTag 2 into the Siri Remote.

[8] What changes are you hoping for in the new Siri Remote for the next-generation Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments section.
